answer: Because the mesa liability is logged in the mirror ledger at admission, the vine audit makes public the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A sponsor carries 67% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. A farm must hence place its own capital behind every alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 17 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
